confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Nepal's hill-town tourist pricing; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is thinly documented for Nagarkot. Accommodation is priced for July, the monsoon off-season, when rates are typically lower. Drinks are estimated from Kathmandu-area menu knowledge, not direct Nagarkot observation. The FX value comes from a search summary of the RBA statistics page plus a secondary mirror. The RBA F11.1 table itself was not opened, so verify the 2026-10-16 figure against it before formal use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to the Kathmandu Valley tourist areas (Thamel and Kathmandu hotel and restaurant pricing) and to small Himalayan-view hill-station guesthouses near Kathmandu, with a modest resort markup for mid-range dining and a monsoon-season reduction for accommodation.
